description: Figure 7 illustrates Micro F1 (%) results for KnowPrompt as a function of the number of training samples generated by LLMs, with four method variants shown as separate lines. The x-axis is labeled “Number of Samples Generated,” uses a linear scale, and has four discrete tick labels: K=8, K=16, K=32, and K=64. The y-axis is labeled “Micro F1 (%)”, uses a linear scale, and spans approximately from 20 to 50 with regularly spaced tick marks at 5-point intervals (20, 25, 30, 35, 40, 45, 50). The blue solid line with circular markers (TACRED) increases from about 22 at K=8 to about 28 at K=16, reaches about 30 at K=32, and is just under 30 at K=64. The orange solid line with circular markers (TACRED+DivInst) follows a similar pattern, starting around 22 at K=8, rising to about 29 at K=16, reaching about 30–31 at K=32, and ending around 30 at K=64. The green solid line with circular markers (Re-TACRED) starts near 35 at K=8, rises to about 39 at K=16, peaks around 48 at K=32, and then decreases slightly to about 46 at K=64. The red solid line with circular markers (Re-TACRED+DivInst) begins around 42 at K=8, increases to about 44 at K=16, rises to about 46 at K=32, and reaches about 48 at K=64.
